metadata.description: This course develops students’ teamwork and workplace communication skills for academic and professional contexts. Students examine how teams function and practice building trust, leadership, and conflict management while communicating effectively in collaborative settings. The course also emphasizes academic integrity, netiquette, and ethical communication as essential principles for responsible participation in academic and professional communities. Through group projects and applied activities, students develop practical skills in writing, presentations, meetings, and career communication.

clos.clo_details: Explain key concepts of teamwork, leadership, and team dynamics in academic and workplace contexts.
Apply teamwork and leadership skills to accomplish group tasks and projects effectively.
Demonstrate effective communication in collaborative settings using emotional intelligence and meeting facilitation techniques.
Analyze and resolve team conflicts using problem-solving and constructive feedback strategies.
Produce professional written documents and deliver clear and persuasive presentations for academic and workplace purposes.
Develop a personal career plan and demonstrate readiness for professional environments.
Demonstrate ethical and responsible communication in teamwork and professional contexts.
